title: Keep a project update from a colleague
instruction: Is this email unsolicited spam or bulk marketing?

state.subject: Revised delivery plan
state.body: Hi Avery, following our planning meeting this morning, I moved the equipment delivery from Wednesday to Friday because the client will be away. The attached spreadsheet contains the revised dates and the same purchase order we approved last week. Please check the two highlighted rows before I send the schedule to the client. There is no new purchase to approve. We can discuss any problems at our usual afternoon call. Thanks, Morgan.

criteria.description: The email is unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.
The email is not unsolicited spam or bulk marketing.

title: Filter a fake prize announcement

title: Same people, opposite money transfer

title: Find a travel-document explanation

state.query: What is the difference between a passport and a boarding pass?
state.document: A passport is a government-issued identity document used for international travel. It identifies the traveler and their nationality, and it can be used for many trips until it expires. A boarding pass is issued by an airline and gives permission to board one particular flight. It shows flight details such as the gate and seat. Checking in online may give you a digital boarding pass, but it does not replace your passport when traveling internationally.
